cues.text:
Loops are simply edges
that point backwards.

Here a writer drafts a
product announcement.

A rule checker written in code, and a
critic model, review it side by side,

and a judge decides whether
to pass, or go round again.
This brief is impossible on purpose:

sixteen words of required
facts, in a ten word limit.

So the loop runs to its
cap of three drafts,
and stops, honestly labelled best effort.
